requirements.Title: AI Productivity, Scan Workflow & Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-powered productivity features, scan workflow automation, and manageability solutions to simplify business operations for SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require ease of management and efficiency due to limited IT resources; AI-driven features will differentiate the product and address key pain points.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with SMB portal and AI solution modules.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product demonstrates AI-powered productivity, scan workflow, and manageability features in customer use cases; validated via usability studies with SMB users.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Design the printer to deliver HP's lowest business TCO for SMBs, including minimal intervention and cost-effective supplies.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs are cost-sensitive and seek ROI and efficiency; low TCO is a key differentiator.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires cost analysis, supply chain optimization, and support for keyed bottles.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: TCO analysis demonstrates lowest cost compared to HP's other business printers and key competitors.

requirements.Title: Sustainable SMB Tank Printer (60% RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure the printer is the most sustainable SMB tank printer, targeting 60% recycled content plastic (RCP) in device construction.
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a growing customer priority and a competitive differentiator (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Dependencies: Material sourcing and manufacturing process changes required.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer BOM and certifications confirm minimum 60% RCP; third-party audit or certification obtained.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Introduce a customer-replaceable maintenance box to minimize downtime and service intervention for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces maintenance complexity and cost for businesses without dedicated IT support.
requirements.Dependencies: Design and service documentation updates; training materials for customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB users can replace maintenance box without HP service intervention; validated by usability testing.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Use keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure ease of use for SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces user errors, improves reliability, and supports cost efficiency.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottles prevent incorrect installation in >99% of test cases.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Printer Management
requirements.Description: Provide a consolidated SMB portal for device management, supporting both unmanaged and lightly managed SMB environments.
requirements.Rationale: Non-IT decision makers need simple, centralized management tools for multiple devices.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with device firmware and cloud services.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal supports all key management functions and is positively rated by SMB user testers (>80% satisfaction).

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS (Platform as a Service)
requirements.Description: Enable the printer to support HP's Platform as a Service (PaaS) offerings, including advanced monitoring and billing features.
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP's business model evolution and customer demand for managed print services.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with HP PaaS backend.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer can be enrolled and managed via HP PaaS; billing and telemetry data are correctly reported.

requirements.Title: Warranty of 80k Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty covering 80,000 pages or 2 years, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Provides assurance to SMB customers and supports HP's value proposition.
requirements.Dependencies: Service and support readiness; warranty terms documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are published and enforced in all supported regions.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: PHA and MINK at Service Centre
requirements.Description: Design for serviceability, allowing customer replaceable parts (PHA) and MINK servicing at service centers if out of warranty.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and total cost of ownership for SMB customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Parts are customer replaceable or serviceable at centers in >90% of cases; documented in service manuals.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL SKU: SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB Portal
requirements.Description: Provide a non-PDL SKU that includes SMB2.0 solutions and the Advanced View SMB portal.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses varying customer needs and supports segmentation.
requirements.Dependencies: Feature differentiation between PDL and non-PDL SKUs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKU ships with SMB2.0 and Advanced View SMB portal enabled.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU: Speed and PS Support
requirements.Description: PDL SKU must deliver improved speeds (target 25/20 ppm) and support for PDL/PS.
requirements.Rationale: Meets performance expectations for higher-end SMB customers and competitive positioning.
requirements.Dependencies: Hardware and firmware support for PDL/PS and speed improvements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves 25/20 ppm in standard test conditions and passes PDL/PS compatibility tests.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure the PDL SKU meets Blue Angel environmental certification requirements.
requirements.Rationale: Environmental certifications are increasingly important for business customers and regulatory compliance.
requirements.Dependencies: Design and documentation compliance with Blue Angel standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU is certified by Blue Angel prior to launch.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan Features
requirements.Description: Implement 'Perfect Print' and 'Perfect Scan' features leveraging AI to optimize output quality and workflow efficiency.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user experience and differentiates product in the market.
requirements.Dependencies: AI solution integration; hardware and software alignment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Feature demos show significant improvement in print/scan quality and workflow efficiency as measured by user testing.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing through the HP App, supporting both Android and iOS platforms.
requirements.Rationale: Mobile printing is a key use case for SMBs and enhances flexibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing is available and functional on HP App for both major mobile OS; passes interoperability tests.

requirements.Title: Advanced Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement advanced telemetry to enable proactive support, usage analytics, and remote monitoring for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Supports manageability, service, and PaaS offerings.
requirements.Dependencies: Cloud and firmware integration; privacy compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is accurate, secure, and accessible via the SMB portal and HP PaaS backend.
